$comment: Single source of truth for LabLink public commercial facts. Every price on the public site and in llms.txt must match this file; tests/pricing.test.mjs enforces it. Change this file first, then the pages, and record the change in docs/lablink-commercial-source-of-truth.md.
source: CareGap owner commit 08677bc (October 2026 Quest Subaccount Fee Schedule)

onboarding.includes: NPI and license verification, Quest subaccount setup or enrollment on CareGap's Quest account, production API keys and BAA
onboarding.appliesTo: every customer: new and existing Quest customers, and customers ordering on CareGap's Quest account

orderPlatformFee.resets: first day of each calendar month

patientRecord.cadence: per patient, per year, billed annually

productionOrdering.source: Owner, 2026-10-30. The LabLink OpenAPI spec still says POST /orders is sandbox only; that text is stale and is being updated in the LabLink docs.

terms: Indicative pricing. Final terms are set in the CareGap Platform Agreement. Fees exclude applicable taxes and are charged to the payment method on file.

retired.$comment: Offers from the retired /quest and /lab-ordering pages. None of these are available. They must not appear on the public site as current terms; tests/legacy-content.test.mjs enforces it.
offers: Ordering on CareGap's Quest account with no setup fee (the earlier /lab-ordering offer; ordering on CareGap's account is available again at standard LabLink pricing)
$0 / no setup fee, sandbox with no card
Testing charged by CareGap at a CareGap testing price list with its own rates (CareGap now passes Quest's price through without markup)
Flat $2.00 per order with $1,500 setup on your own account (original /quest page)
Cash pay only, no insurance billing

questAccounts.$comment: Ways a customer can work with Quest. Platform fees are the same for all of them. Owner, 2026-11-07.

ownAccount.description: An existing Quest account, or a new Quest subaccount CareGap files for the customer
ownAccount.testing: Billed by Quest according to each order's bill type
ownAccount.interfaceRequest: Needed for a new subaccount; Quest says 4-6 weeks

caregapAccount.description: Ordering on CareGap's Quest account, with no Quest account of the customer's own
caregapAccount.testing: CareGap pays Quest and charges the payment method on file, when the order is placed, Quest's price for the order's testing, including any specimen collection fee, with no markup
caregapAccount.interfaceRequest: None; Quest adds the verified ordering provider's NPI to CareGap's account
caregapAccount.providerAcknowledgment: Each ordering provider signs an acknowledgment with CareGap
